title: Operación Cóndor
goal: Read how the Southern Cone dictatorships built a coordinated transnational network to hunt exiled dissidents across borders, including the 1976 assassination of Orlando Letelier in Washington, DC, and the 1992 discovery of the Terror Archives.

items: State when and where Operation Condor was formalized, and by whom.
Explain what the participating dictatorships coordinated to do.
Describe what happened to Orlando Letelier in September 1976.
Explain what Martín Almada discovered in December 1992.
Use por medio de to name a concrete mechanism.
